channel.title: NeedPro Guides
channel.description: Visas, insurance, SIM cards, money and moving abroad: answers from official sources, each with the date it was checked.

item.title: Personal item size: what fits under the seat in 2026
item.description: A personal item must fit under the seat in front of you. Ryanair and Wizz Air allow 40x30x20 cm, AirAsia 40x30x10 cm. Check your airline before you pack.

item.title: Checked bag weight limit: 23 kg, 32 kg and your fare
item.description: IATA guidelines recommend up to 23 kg (50 lb) for a checked bag; 32 kg (70 lb) is the single-bag maximum in many regions. Your fare sets the real allowance.

item.title: TSA liquid rule: 3.4 oz, one quart bag, exceptions
item.description: TSA lets you carry liquids in containers of 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less in one quart-sized bag. Medicine, baby formula and frozen items are exceptions.

item.title: Carry-on size limits: 22 x 14 x 9 and the exceptions
item.description: Most big US airlines cap carry-ons at 22 x 14 x 9 inches including wheels; Southwest allows 24 x 16 x 10. Budget airlines are stricter. Limits checked 2026.

item.title: How early to arrive at the airport: 2 or 3 hours?
item.description: TSA advises 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 before an international one. Airlines' hard cutoffs are shorter: 45 minutes to check a bag on AA and Delta.

item.title: Do I need a passport for Puerto Rico? 2026 ID rules
item.description: US citizens flying from the mainland need no passport for Puerto Rico, only a TSA-accepted ID. Foreign visitors need a US visa or ESTA. Rules checked 2026.

item.title: Do you need a passport for Hawaii? ID rules for 2026
item.description: US citizens don't need a passport for Hawaii: TSA accepts a REAL ID license. Foreign visitors need a visa or ESTA, because Hawaii is part of the US.

item.title: Do I need a passport to go to Mexico? Air vs land rules
item.description: Flying to Mexico, US citizens need a passport book. By land, a passport card works for border crossings and the border zone. Official rules, Nov 2026.

item.title: Turkey visa for Pakistani citizens: e-Visa or sticker visa
item.description: Pakistani passport holders need a visa for Türkiye. The e-Visa needs a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or permit; everyone else goes to a consulate.

item.title: Switzerland vignette: CHF 40 price, dates and e-vignette
item.description: Every car on Swiss motorways needs a CHF 40 vignette. The 2027 one runs 1 December 2026 to 31 January 2028. Buy it online or as a sticker; the fine is CHF 200.

item.title: Passport validity checker: is your passport OK to travel?
item.description: Pick a destination, enter your passport and trip dates: the checker shows the date your passport must be valid until, by the official rule and its check date.

item.title: Crit'Air sticker: who needs one, price and how to order
item.description: You need a Crit'Air sticker to drive in French low-emission zones, foreign plates included. Order only at certificat-air.gouv.fr: €3.85 to France; fine €68.

item.title: Travel insurance for winter sports: what it must cover
item.description: Standard travel policies usually exclude skiing. What winter sports cover needs: rescue, repatriation, off-piste and kit, and why the EHIC is not enough.

item.title: Christmas markets in Europe 2026: dates and entry rules
item.description: 2026 dates from city pages: Vienna from 13 November, Dresden 25 November, Nuremberg and Strasbourg 27 November. Plus passport and Schengen rules for visitors.

item.title: Spain digital nomad visa: income, routes and 2026 figure
item.description: Spain's teleworker visa asks for 200% of the minimum wage: €2,442 a month in 2026. You apply at the consulate where you live, or from inside Spain.

item.title: DTV visa Thailand: 2026 rules, money and limits
item.description: Thailand's DTV gives 5 years of multiple entry, 180 days per entry. You need 500,000 baht and, since 31 August 2026, residency where you apply.

item.title: Working in China as a foreigner: permits and rules
item.description: Foreigners can work in China with a job offer, a work permit and a work-type residence permit. Category B asks for a degree and 2 years' experience.

item.title: How to change App Store country: Apple's checklist
item.description: Spend your balance, cancel subscriptions and wait for them to end, finish pre-orders, then go to Settings, your name, Media & Purchases, Country/Region.

item.title: VAT refund in Vietnam for tourists: 60 days, 85% back
item.description: Foreign visitors get 85% of Vietnam's VAT back on goods worth VND 2,000,000+ per shop per day, invoiced within 60 days before departure. How to claim it.

item.title: International student working hours in Canada: 24 a week
item.description: A Canadian study permit allows up to 24 hours a week off campus in term and unlimited hours in scheduled breaks. Who qualifies, and the SIN that starts with 9.

item.title: Can Netflix be used in different countries? EU rules
item.description: Yes: your account works abroad, but the catalog follows the country you're in. Inside the EU a paid plan must stay the same. Moving means a new signup.

item.title: Flying with a dog from Europe to the US: CDC rules
item.description: A dog flying from the EU or UK to the US needs a free CDC Dog Import Form receipt, a microchip and to be 6+ months old. Ukraine, Turkey, Russia are high-risk.

item.title: Turkey work permit: the two routes and who applies
item.description: A Turkish work permit comes before your first day. The employer files it, using a 16-digit consulate reference or your 6-month residence permit.

item.title: ENIC-NARIC: what the centres do and who decides
item.description: ENIC-NARIC links recognition centres in 56 countries. They inform; a university or a named authority decides. Your rights under the Lisbon Convention.

item.title: VAT refund for tourists: rules in 6 countries compared
item.description: Non-residents can reclaim VAT on goods they take home. Spain, Italy, Portugal, Australia and Vietnam compared: minimum, deadline, where to claim. Canada: none.

item.title: How to bring a pet to another country: the real rules
item.description: The destination sets the rules, but most build on one standard: microchip, rabies shot, titer test 3-12 months before travel. US and Australia timelines.

item.title: Is medical insurance mandatory in the UAE? Visas, residency
item.description: Yes for residents in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, and for some tourist visas: Dubai's single-entry visa and the five-year visa need a policy valid in the UAE.

item.title: TM30 in Thailand: who files it and why it matters
item.description: TM30 is the address report your Thai landlord or hotel must file with immigration within 24 hours of your arrival. It is not the TDAC arrival card.

item.title: How long is ESTA valid? 2 years, and the 90-day stay
item.description: CBP says an ESTA is usually valid for 2 years or until your passport expires, whichever is sooner. Each stay is capped at 90 days and ends on your I-94 date.

item.title: Barcelona tourist tax 2026: rates per night from BOE
item.description: Since 1 April 2026 Barcelona charges a Catalan base rate (€4.50 a night in a tourist flat, €7 in a 5-star) plus a city surcharge capped at €8.
